item.title: General Atomics investing more than $25 million to expand operations in Lee County
item.description: California-based defense technology company General Atomics is expanding its footprint in northeast Mississippi with a $25 million investment. The Mississippi Development Authority announced Tuesday that the company is building upon its operations in Shannon, where its Electromagnetic Systems Group has been housed for 21 years. To support the production of next-generation defense systems, including Bullseye, […]

item.title: SuperTalk Eagle Hour 3/3/2026
item.description: Sam Sklar, beat writer for Mississippi State athletics at the Clarion Ledger, returns to go in-depth into tonight’s Southern Miss/Mississippi State game at The Pete. Plus, former Southern Miss pitcher and Eagle Hour baseball analyst Daniel Stewart join Bob and Dima.

item.description: Delta State University will use $1.75 million in federal funding to help train future agricultural pilots. Officials announced that the funding was made available by the FY2026 Labor, Health and Human Services, and Education Appropriations Bill, signed into law by President Donald Trump in February.
